notes: Community Heat rules (design thread, 26 Sep 2026). Heat = heat_base + load + grievance + era, clamped to 0-100. Load = sites.json heat_load_max x running MW / site capacity MW (garage: machines.json heat_per_unit_garage per running unit). hostile_council multiplies every increase (load, grievance, era) by its heat_growth_mult.

community_deal.note: M19 (design thread 4 Oct 2026, designed): the Community Relations Manager's yearly deal. Offered every every_quarters quarters on the hottest site at min_heat or more (tie: the larger; garage excluded); signing sets Heat to target_heat now through an offset that moves fade_per_quarter toward 0 at each quarter end. Cost per_mw x the site's MW, between min and max.
